title: Odile and the Crown
author: E. M. Underhill
blurb: Beatrix Delacroix, a thief who steals memories, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
